# 0.5.9

## 本次更新

- 修正作品访问状态解析：受限、成年与登录可见的作品按真实原因展示，不再把需要登录的成年内容误标为付费内容。
- 网页请求被拒、周期性检查与回到前台都会触发会话复核，确认失效后提示刷新 Cookie。周期检查复用 5 分钟健康缓存，网络或挑战页面不会被直接判断为过期。
- 图片、视频与下载失败中的 401/403 现在也接入同一会话校验链：过期 Cookie 不再只表现为图片裂图或下载失败，而是会引导刷新；真正付费的内容不会触发登录提醒。
- 关闭会话提醒后，切换页面不会重复弹出；登录恢复会清空关闭记录，后续失效仍会再次提醒。

## Fixes（English）

- Resolve artwork access states by their real cause so mature or login-gated works are no longer mislabeled as paid content.
- Recheck the web session after web rejections, periodically and when returning to the foreground; prompt after confirmed expiry. Periodic checks reuse a five-minute healthy verdict, and network failures or challenges do not directly mean expiry.
- Route 401/403 failures from images, video and downloads into the same session verification chain: an expired Cookie now leads to a refresh prompt instead of silent broken media, while genuinely paid content never triggers one.
- Share dismissed session notices across routes and reset them after confirmed recovery, so a later expiry can prompt again.
